This is all of evangelion in 1080p adv dub spent some time compiling and splicing audio files across the different versions since there is no digitally available 1080p version of evangelion with the ADV dub only with the shitty netflix one and that pmo

if you want my personal recommendation on how I think this show should be watched
in vlc player in the Video section find Deinterlance mode and turn it on, than on the one under it click Phosphor for a deeper contrast made specifically for older shows made to mimic a CRT tv, which is how the show was intended to be watched while aring on 4:3 screens, if thats not your thing tho you can make the deinterlance mode "Yadif" or "Yadif 2x" to make the image a little bit more crisp

EDIT: THE MP4 FILES ARE LOW QUALITY SUB idk why that happened but its probably because the og files i got were low quality dual audio (sub and dub) which you can control but archive prolly fucked i up somewhere just
ONLY DOWNLOAD .mkv FILES 

EDIT AGAIN: DOWNLOAD MKV FILES ONLY, IN VLC PLAYER IF THE AUDIO IS IN JAPANESE OR VSI NETFLIX JUST PUT YOUR CURSOR TO THE TOP OF YOUR SCREEN, CLICK AUDIO AND PRESS MANGA ENTERTAINMENT OR ADV DUB, AND IF YOU CAN HEAR SOME SOUNDS BUT NOT OTHERS like gunshots but you cant hear any characters speaking in that same audio menu change stereo type to MONO, the movie has a 5.1 sound audio system made to go through 6 channels aka speakers in a surround sound system changing your stereo system to mono makes all audio go through all available speakers at once

again; please download the .mkv files idk why there are mp4's just a glitch the intended file is the .mkv

made this for a friend who wanted to watch this show but couldnt stand 480p i wanted him to experience the show the way I did since the adv dub makes this serious deep show funnier and imo makes it better

if your device cannot natively play .mkv files consider downloading VLC media player and it should work, you can enable subtitles via the subtitles button that appears when you play the video, same goes for the dub in the movie 



i also fixed ep16, i found an upscaled version of that ep in 1080p and spliced in the dub, so there will be sub already there mb js live w it since its better than nothing or a shitty 480p version of it so do as you will with that

this file i spliced up incudes 
Neon Genesis Evangelion (1-26) 1080p ADV dub

Death and Rebirth Manga Ent dub 1080p Blu-ray
---forced sub for 6 minutes throughout the movie since the dvd i used to get the manga entertainment dub had extra scenes compared to the 1080p old blu ray that only had sub.

Episodes 1, 8, 9, 10, 12, 16, 25, 26 doesn't have a proper title for the episode. It only reads the file name.
Episodes 2-4 reads as "Neon Genesis Evangelion: 01 - Angel Attack"
Episodes 17, 18, 19, 20, reads as "Neon Genesis Evangelion: 15 - Lies and Silence / Those women longed for the touch of others' lips, and thus invited their kisses."
Episodes 23 and 24 reads as "Neon Genesis Evangelion: 22 - At Least, Be Human / Don't Be."

Episodes 5, 6, 11, 13, 14, 15, 21, 22 have correct codecs.

Episode 26's file name also consists a typo with the file name being "evadubedep26" over the "evadubbedep#" that's used for the rest of the file names.
